lines: I adopted a beagle called Pixel from the shelter yesterday.
Congratulations! How is Pixel settling in?
Pixel sleeps all day and chews my slippers.
a small dog on a sofa
I started learning the cello last week.
That sounds lovely, my café’s cellist said it takes years.
My cello teacher, Meera, lives in Pune.
I ran the Mysore half marathon in 2 hours 5 minutes.
Great time. What is next for you?
I plan to visit Hampi in December.
Pixel turned one and we celebrated with a walk by the lake.
Meera says I can play at the recital in August.
